raw: [name="Delphine"]I thought you would reject my proposal.
speaker: Delphine
content: I thought you would reject my proposal.

raw: [name="Vina"]The important thing is to win this final battle. Everything else is secondary.
speaker: Vina
content: The important thing is to win this final battle. Everything else is secondary.

speaker: Delphine
content: The scion of Cumberland yet lives?

raw: [name="Vina"]I hope so. She deserves a second chance, no matter what.
speaker: Vina
content: I hope so. She deserves a second chance, no matter what.

raw: [name="Delphine"]What about you? Do you understand the significance of donning this garment?
speaker: Delphine
content: What about you? Do you understand the significance of donning this garment?

raw: [name="Vina"]I do. But I always had a choice, didn't I?
speaker: Vina
content: I do. But I always had a choice, didn't I?

raw: Vina walks through the crowd, escorted by Delphine. Everyone bows to her in reverence.
content: Vina walks through the crowd, escorted by Delphine. Everyone bows to her in reverence.

speaker: Vina
content: This is hard to take, though...

raw: She thought she saw a certain figure in the crowd, drowned out by the onrushing soldiers and citizens.
content: She thought she saw a certain figure in the crowd, drowned out by the onrushing soldiers and citizens.

speaker: Delphine
content: What is it?

raw: [name="Vina"]...Nothing. Let's get the troops in order. It's time to put an end to this.
speaker: Vina
content: ...Nothing. Let's get the troops in order. It's time to put an end to this.

raw: 'You and your friends will win, Vina. The present I left you, the garb that always belonged to you, is merely icing on the cake of your final victory.'
content: 'You and your friends will win, Vina. The present I left you, the garb that always belonged to you, is merely icing on the cake of your final victory.'

raw: 'There is no place for me by your side when victory comes. This is the choice that I made.'
content: 'There is no place for me by your side when victory comes. This is the choice that I made.'

raw: 'But the end of this absurd war is simply the beginning of your story. Can you remain the ever-victorious legend when that time comes?'
content: 'But the end of this absurd war is simply the beginning of your story. Can you remain the ever-victorious legend when that time comes?'

raw: 'Victoria is not easily changed by anyone, not even you.'
content: 'Victoria is not easily changed by anyone, not even you.'

raw: 'But perhaps, I would truly have believed—'
content: 'But perhaps, I would truly have believed—'
'Goodbye, Vina... Goodbye.'
